newsitem.title: PERU: Congressman says one dead in Peru storming.
newsitem.headline: Congressman says one dead in Peru storming.

text.p: A government congressman said Supreme Court judge Carlos Giusti Acuna died when Peruvian troops stormed the besieged Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima on Tuesday.

"It has come out in Congress -- through the information received -- that the dead man is Giusti," Congressman Daniel Espichan told Reuters, in reference to the judge. Local television and radion alo said the judge had died.
